speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin understanding your skin lesions, can you tell me how long you have had them and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chickenpox (Varicella). The history of a brother with chickenpox one month ago and the child's attendance at a daycare with a similar case strongly suggest transmission of the varicella-zoster virus, even though the mother reports the lesions as painless and non-itchy, which is atypical but possible in early stages or specific viral strains. I will confirm the diagnosis by reviewing any available images of the lesions. REQUEST IMAGES
